question: Amit said that his father's mother's only daughter - in - law's daughter's father gave him a gift. Who gave the gift to Amit?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

 
• Amit said that his father's mother's only daughter - in - law's daughter's father gave him a gift.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a22bf56e492932c1ca0c3bfa3738f0695c484e23a4cbfd84c158943b7ed79d1b.png] 

Hence, 'His Father' gave Amit the gift.
